title: Measurement Wheel

useCase.name: Penny Measurement
useCase.description: The Penny Proportiyn.Penny divides a diameter line into one equal part.

model: A straight line through the center of the circle (a diameter) is divided into 1 equal parts and can be rotated to any angle.
notes: Same diameter-division principle as every other Proportiyn.Penny — only the subdivision count changes. When the count is even, one division point falls exactly on the center; when it's odd, the center sits between two marks instead.
